profile.name: Keithley 485 皮安计
profile.description: Keithley 485 是一款4位半分辨率、自动量程的皮安计，用于测量极低电流，量程覆盖约 0.1 pA 到 2 mA。它适合实验室中的微弱电流检测，如器件漏电流、传感器输出电流和光电探测电流测量。
profile.description_en: The Keithley 485 is a 4.5-digit autoranging picoammeter for measuring very low currents, covering roughly 0.1 pA to 2 mA. It is used in laboratories for weak-current measurements such as device leakage current, sensor output current, and photocurrent measurements.

registry.name: Keithley 485 Autoranging Picoammeter
registry.description: Keithley 485 Autoranging Picoammeter是由Keithley (Tektronix)生产的表征设备，主要功能包括归零校准、日志记录、测量、状态查询、自动量程、触发。
